svg.title: OP-01 — VIDI: It sees the world so they can walk it.

g.text: It sees the world so they can walk it.
A voice-first AI companion for blind and low-vision users. YOLOv8,
Depth Anything V2, OCR and face recognition run on OpenVINO, and a
Gemini Live agent speaks only what perception actually saw.
~390 ms to first spoken word, with barge-in
14 grounded tools, so it never invents obstacles
